Growth retardation. The use of a gonadorelin analogue to de- lay precocious puberty may improve the final height of children with the disorder. However, the use of a gonadorelin analogue with growth hormone in short but otherwise normal children is controversial—see under Triptorelin, p.2136. Hirsutism. For reference to the use of gonadorelin analogues such as leuprorelin in the treatment of hirsutism, see p.2112. Infertility. Gonadorelin and its analogues are used in the man- agement of infertility related to hypogonadotrophic hypogonad- ism in both women and men (p.2080). Some further references are given below. See also under Buserelin Acetate, p.2083, Leu- prorelin Acetate, p.2112, and Nafarelin Acetate, p.2118.
